# A fresh controlled comparison of A2 (D586): provenance check and design, version 1, nothing sent

## 1. Provenance: no stored topic set is held out

| Stored topics | Used in developing arms A to A3 |
|---|---|
| July (three runs, about 40 topics) | the probes' motivating, recovery, refusal and disputed topics; PROMPT-AUDIT-LINE-2 §7 recount; DECLINE-AUDIT read all 66 descriptions and outcomes |
| fortnight (13 topics) | the probes' motivating, regression and harm-control topics; CENSUS.md |
| week of 10-06 (13 topics) | the probes; CENSUS.md; d436-reading |
| week of 09-22 (7 questions) | PROMPT-AUDIT-LINE-2 (the line-2 failures that started the line) |
| carried library (10-06 articles) | the same week's matters as above |
| Alex's 44 (Stage A) | the ladder step's own design; D426: not tuned further |

**Conclusion:** fresh topics need the first step to open them from articles no new-system run has read.
- **The candidate source is the week of 2026-10-13..19:** 383 eligible articles, 19 of them seen before (`second-week/exposure-summary.json`).
- **The overlap I expect:** recurring NVIDIA matters (an acquisition, an approval) will reappear. Each fresh topic's matter is therefore
  compared, before any answer is read, with the 28 probe topics' matters. One on the same matter is reported apart and left out of
  the decision.

## 2. Design

- **The first step:** clean Step 1 as frozen (c8, D427), on the first three days of 2026-10-13..19 in source order, minus the seen-before
  articles.
  - **Starting library:** the completed library of the week of 10-06 (`poc/data/clean-second-week-2026-11-15/week-continued/c1`),
    which is real earlier material (D559). The entry point and starting state are proven at $0 first, as for the carried library
    (`carried-library/carried_library_proof.py`).
  - **Ledger:** a new one with a ceiling of $2.00. The estimate is about $1.7 at the 10-06 week's per-article charge; it is checked by
    a dry run first.
- **The answer-choice step:** for each topic the first step opens, the frozen request (control) and A2, three sends each, the same
  day. A2's files are as checked in D582 (`arm-a2/`).
- **The reading:** the unchanged gate-1 form (Alex's six lines; `clean-arch/step4-2026-11-10/ladder/stage-a-reader-brief.md`), with
  H added and reported, never a veto. Two families, third readers of both, and three planted controls.
- **The expected effect on the reader (D391):** the product shows "Not judged" parts beside an answer (D570). When a part is left
  unlisted, the card hides that the answer ignored it (a cap on an approval, a second year). A2 should make the card honest about its
  scope. It is not expected to change the judged answer itself.

## 3. The decision, written now

Population: the topics opened, minus those on a probe topic's matter (n). Fewer than 5 is "not measured".

- **Lead** needs all of these:
  1. **Omitted parts lower:** A2 fails L on fewer topics than the control, and on at most 1.
  2. **No more unjustified refusals:** A2's N-failing sends are at most the control's.
  3. **No reproducible regression:** no other line or mark fails on more topics, in 2 of 3 sends, for A2 than for the control.
     A topic counts here only when its fault recurs in 2 of 3 sends, which answers the control-against-control spread seen in
     `control-vs-control.txt`.
- **Inconclusive:** the control fails L on fewer than 2 topics (not exercised), or the countings disagree.
- **Otherwise negative.**

The lines are Alex's six as read, on this population. They are not his 44-topic thresholds, and no scaled pass of his gate is
claimed. H, the extra listed items, is printed per topic beside the result.

**Cost:** about $1.7 for the first step plus about $0.05 for the answer choices. The spend so far is about $26.55 of $40.

# Finishing the week of 10-06 as a diagnostic: the matching, the judge and a reading of the last answers (D558, under D439), 2026-11-15

**Not started. It starts only on Alex's word.** It spends, and the order of the gates is his. It passes no gate.

## What it would show, and what it would not

The week's questions exist (11 of the 13 topics have written answer choices in the first attempt, which is the one the judge
uses), but nobody has seen how the system answers them: the matching and the judge were not run (D553). Finishing the week
shows whether the answers to the questions that exist are supported by what the judge was shown, on a second week outside the
tuned days, beside the fresh week (6 of 7 last answers supported by both reader families). It does not show anything about
the two spending topics that got no question, nor whether a fact that never reached an answer would have changed it, nor a
rate: one week, one run, a week continued after a stall.

## The run

- **Inputs, unchanged:** the merged trace of the 272 articles, the 13 topics and all three attempts of the answer choices, as
  stored in `poc/data/clean-second-week-2026-11-15/week-continued/c1/`. That draw and its record are not touched.
- **How:** `prepare_continued_draw.prepare_completion` copies those three into a new draw
  (`poc/data/clean-second-week-2026-11-15/week-completed/c1/`), each recorded as completed and copied; the unchanged runner
  (`run_fresh.py clean`) then runs what is left, the matching and the judge, on a ledger of its own.
- **Proved at $0** (`completion_entry_proof.py`, `proofs/completion-entry.control.txt`): on the stored fresh week a draw prepared
  this way, run by the unchanged runner with every call answered from the stored archives under a live reservation, gives the
  stored library, the stored decisions, the same judge request for every question on every day and the same 37 judgements;
  665 calls, none unreserved, none unknown; the copied inputs unchanged. Its mutant (the first two attempts of the answer

**No-go on v1 for building.** Fresh news and a carried library are a useful next condition, but the design needs a defensible population and comparison rule before the paid run.

- **The starting library is real, but it is not a continuous product history.** The referenced 10-06 week began from empty; its continuation completed that week after a stall. Carrying its final library into 10-13 is a better test of an existing-library condition than another empty start, but it does not represent a library accumulated across earlier weeks. Also, removing previously seen articles changes what the library would encounter during the slice; report that condition and the omitted articles. [D559](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:6976>), [continuation design](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/second-week/COMPLETION-DESIGN.md>)

- **The provenance check is incomplete.** The exposure file supports 383 eligible and 19 previously encountered at the time it was made, but explicitly excludes source-page work. Recheck exposure through the present run, including article identity and materially repeated stories. Comparing new topics only with the 28 probe topics does not establish independence from the other matters used to develop the step. Record all opened topics and make same-matter and uncertain classifications before reading either arm’s answers; define who makes them and how disagreements are handled. [Exposure summary](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/second-week/exposure-summary.json>), [v1 design](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/FRESH-A2-DESIGN.md>)

- **The regression rule is not calibrated by the evidence cited.** Requiring a fault on two of three sends may miss a real regression that occurs once per topic; the prior control comparison counted sends and does not establish the error rate of this new topic-level rule. Report *all* six lines under their unchanged accounting, including every failing send and both treatments of disagreements. A comparative lead can be a separate diagnostic, but must not hide a one-send failure or imply Alex’s zero-fault lines passed. [Control comparison](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/control-vs-control.txt>), [D400](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/DECISIONS-log.md:4376>)

- **Size the first three days before committing to them.** The design does not show their eligible article count, their order, or why the $1.7 estimate and $2 ceiling cover the starting library, reservations and retries. The number of resulting eligible topics is unknown; fewer than five—or too few control L failures—can leave the paid run uninformative. Show those limits in the pre-send proof and price the ladder calls and reader sessions separately; their cost is not established by the pipeline estimate. [v1 design](</Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/unlisted-parts/FRESH-A2-DESIGN.md>)
